short_description: A1 graph-only baseline: fused interaction graph with a global DimeNet encoder; no protein context and no ligand descriptors.
A1 sequence-only baseline: frozen whole-protein ESM context without graph geometry or ligand descriptors.
A1 hybrid baseline: global DimeNet interaction-graph encoder plus frozen whole-protein ESM context; no ligand descriptors.
A1 full baseline: global DimeNet interaction-graph encoder plus frozen whole-protein ESM context and ligand RDKit descriptors.
A2 coarse-to-local baseline: global DimeNet branch plus local DimeNet branch, frozen whole-protein ESM context, ligand RDKit descriptors, and local chemistry enrichment disabled.
A2 chemistry-enriched variant: global DimeNet branch plus local DimeNet branch, frozen whole-protein ESM context, ligand RDKit descriptors, and local chemistry summaries enabled.

A3 explicit-mixture baseline: global DimeNet branch plus local DimeNet branch with a linear coarse/local mixer and trainable bias, frozen whole-protein ESM context, ligand RDKit descriptors, and local chemistry enrichment disabled.

A3 bias-free explicit-mixture baseline: global DimeNet branch plus local DimeNet branch with a linear coarse/local mixer and no bias term, frozen whole-protein ESM context, ligand RDKit descriptors, and local chemistry enrichment disabled.

A3 chemistry-enriched mixture variant: global DimeNet branch plus local DimeNet branch with a linear coarse/local mixer and trainable bias, frozen whole-protein ESM context, ligand RDKit descriptors, and local chemistry summaries enabled.

A3 bias-free chemistry-enriched mixture variant: global DimeNet branch plus local DimeNet branch with a linear coarse/local mixer and no bias term, frozen whole-protein ESM context, ligand RDKit descriptors, and local chemistry summaries enabled.
A2 SchNet-local variant: global DimeNet branch plus local SchNet branch, frozen whole-protein ESM context, ligand RDKit descriptors, and local chemistry enrichment disabled.
A2 SchNet-local chemistry-enriched variant: global DimeNet branch plus local SchNet branch, frozen whole-protein ESM context, ligand RDKit descriptors, and local chemistry summaries enabled.

A3 SchNet-local mixture variant: global DimeNet branch plus local SchNet branch with a linear coarse/local mixer and trainable bias, frozen whole-protein ESM context, ligand RDKit descriptors, and local chemistry enrichment disabled.

A3 bias-free SchNet-local mixture variant: global DimeNet branch plus local SchNet branch with a linear coarse/local mixer and no bias term, frozen whole-protein ESM context, ligand RDKit descriptors, and local chemistry enrichment disabled.

A3 SchNet-local chemistry-enriched mixture variant: global DimeNet branch plus local SchNet branch with a linear coarse/local mixer and trainable bias, frozen whole-protein ESM context, ligand RDKit descriptors, and local chemistry summaries enabled.

A3 bias-free SchNet-local chemistry-enriched mixture variant: global DimeNet branch plus local SchNet branch with a linear coarse/local mixer and no bias term, frozen whole-protein ESM context, ligand RDKit descriptors, and local chemistry summaries enabled.

A2 quantum-readout variant: global DimeNet branch plus local DimeNet branch, frozen whole-protein ESM context, ligand RDKit descriptors, local chemistry enrichment disabled, and a VQC head replacing the default MLP readout.

A2 quantum-readout chemistry-enriched variant: global DimeNet branch plus local DimeNet branch, frozen whole-protein ESM context, ligand RDKit descriptors, local chemistry summaries enabled, and a VQC head replacing the default MLP readout.
